name: Fireball
description: Wind up, throw a blazing fireball that explodes where it lands.

name: Lightning Strike
description: Raise a crackling hand and call a bolt down in front of you.

name: Healing Aura
description: Arms open, a green ring rises and heals everyone standing in it.

name: Ground Slam
description: Leap, then smash the ground: shockwave, flying rocks and dust.

name: Frost Nova
description: R6: gather cold, then blast a ring of ice shards outward.

name: Blade Slash
description: A fast sweeping slash with a glowing blade trail and a wind arc.

name: Stand Barrage
description: A ghostly Stand appears behind you, rushes in front and unleashes a barrage of punches, then returns.

name: Spirit Sword
description: A glowing blade grows in your hand for one wide slash, then fades.

name: Earth Wall
description: Slam the ground and three rock pillars burst up in front of you, then sink back.
